:= by
  let f' : ι → M → K := f
  let s : Set ι := univ
  let v : ι → M := λ i, (f i).ker_comp_zero
  have hli : LinearIndepOn K v s :=
    by intro i j hne; rw [LinearIndepOn.def, hne]; intro h; rw [v]; exact (f i).ker_comp_zero.eq_zero.mp h
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := Module.exists_dual_forall_apply_eq_one K M f'
  use g
  intro i
  apply hg i
